Campfire recipe

Minty Succulent Fish

Minty Succulent Fish is a campfire recipe in Red Dead Redemption 2, made at your own campfire as often as you have the ingredients. It takes 1 Succulent Fish Meat and 1 Wild Mint.

Type
Provision
Made at
Campfire

Description

  • Fully restores Health Core. Greatly restores Stamina Core and Dead Eye Core.

Ingredients

  • 1xSucculent Fish Meat
  • 1xWild Mint
